contexts.text: An online order is created when OrbitTech displays an order number and sends a confirmation email. A pending card authorization is not proof that the order was accepted.

qa_pairs.question: How long does standard domestic shipping normally take after dispatch?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Standard domestic shipping normally takes three to five business days after dispatch; this is an estimate, not a guarantee.

contexts.text: Standard domestic shipping normally arrives in three to five business days after dispatch. Express shipping normally arrives in one to two business days after dispatch. These are service estimates, not guarantees.

qa_pairs.question: How long is the return window for an opened standard device under the current policy, and is there a fee?

qa_pairs.question: My order page shows only a pending card authorization. Has the order been accepted, and when can I cancel it?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A pending card authorization is not proof that the order was accepted; an order is created when OrbitTech displays an order number and sends a confirmation email. An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is Confirmed. Once it is Packing, cancellation is not guaranteed.

contexts.text: An online order is created when OrbitTech displays an order number and sends a confirmation email. A pending card authorization is not proof that the order was accepted.
An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is `Confirmed`. Once the status becomes `Packing`, cancellation is no longer guaranteed.

qa_pairs.question: Can I combine an OrbitPlus accessory discount with a percentage-off promo code?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. OrbitPlus accessory discounts cannot stack with a percentage-off code; checkout applies the larger eligible discount. Only one percentage-off code may be used on an order.

contexts.text: Only one percentage-off promotional code may be applied to an order. A percentage code may be combined with a gift card, but not with another percentage code or a clearance markdown.
OrbitPlus accessory discounts cannot stack with a percentage-off code; checkout applies the larger eligible discount.

qa_pairs.question: When can support open a carrier trace for a delayed package, and can I get a refund during the investigation?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A package is considered delayed when tracking has no update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date. Support may then open a carrier trace. A refund or replacement is not issued while an active trace is within its five-business-day investigation period.

contexts.text: A package is considered delayed when it has no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date. At that point, support may open a carrier trace.
A refund or replacement is not issued while an active trace is within its five-business-day investigation period.

qa_pairs.question: How does OrbitTech process an exchange, and when are refunds issued after inspection?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An exchange is processed as a return plus a new order, so price differences, current promotions, and stock availability apply to the new order. After inspection, refunds go to the original payment methods within five to seven business days.

contexts.text: An exchange is processed as a return plus a new order; price differences, current promotions, and stock availability apply to the new order.
After inspection, refunds are issued to the original payment methods within five to seven business days.

qa_pairs.question: Is accidental impact damage covered by the limited warranty, and what remedies can warranty service provide?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Accidental impact is excluded from the limited warranty. After diagnosis, warranty service may provide a repair, an equivalent new or refurbished replacement, or a refund if the first two remedies are not reasonable; OrbitTech chooses the remedy.

contexts.text: The warranty excludes loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure, electrical damage from an unsupported charger, unauthorized modification, and repair by a non-authorized provider.
Warranty service may result in repair, replacement with an equivalent new or refurbished unit, or refund when the first two remedies are not reasonable. OrbitTech chooses the remedy after diagnosis.

qa_pairs.question: What are the normal diagnosis and covered-repair timelines, and what happens if a required part is unavailable for over 15 business days?

qa_pairs.question: What should I do if I suspect my OrbitTech account was compromised, especially if an unauthorized order is still Confirmed?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: From a trusted device, reset the password, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. If the unauthorized order is still Confirmed, also attempt cancellation; if it is packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with Payments and Delivery, but cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.

contexts.text: A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security.

If an unauthorized order is still `Confirmed`, the customer should also attempt cancellation under `02_orders_and_payments.md`. If it is already packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with the Payments and Delivery teams; cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.

qa_pairs.question: I placed an order on August 20, 2026, while OrbitPlus was active. Which unopened-device return window applies, and does the new policy change it?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The order uses Return Policy version 1.0 because it was placed before September 1, 2026. That version allows 21 calendar days from confirmed delivery for unopened devices. The 45-day OrbitPlus extension was introduced with version 2.0 and applies only when OrbitPlus was active on the order date for version 2.0 orders, so it does not retroactively extend this pre-September order.

contexts.text: Return Policy version 1.0 applies to orders placed before September 1, 2026. It allowed 21 calendar days for unopened devices, seven calendar days for opened devices, and charged a 15% opened-device restocking fee. Return Policy version 2.0 applies to orders placed on or after September 1, 2026. It allows 30 days unopened, 14 days opened, and charges 10%. The 45-day OrbitPlus unopened-device benefit was introduced with version 2.0.
Orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day version 1.0 window regardless of membership. For version 2.0 orders, the extension applies only when OrbitPlus was active on the order date.

qa_pairs.question: A USD 1,200 order is going to a designated remote area by standard domestic shipping. How should I estimate delivery time, and may the carrier leave the package unattended?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Standard domestic shipping normally takes three to five business days after dispatch, and a designated remote area requires two additional business days; this is still an estimate, not a guarantee. Because the device is valued above USD 1,000, an adult signature is required, and OrbitTech does not authorize the carrier to leave it unattended.

contexts.text: Standard domestic shipping normally arrives in three to five business days after dispatch. Express shipping normally arrives in one to two business days after dispatch. These are service estimates, not guarantees. Orders to designated remote areas require two additional business days. Weekends and public carrier holidays are not business days.

Orders containing devices valued above USD 1,000 require an adult signature. A customer may request carrier pickup after the first failed delivery attempt, but the carrier may require identification matching the shipment name. OrbitTech does not authorize a carrier to leave a signature-required package unattended.

qa_pairs.question: My opened NovaBook has a verified defect 20 days after delivery. Is it still returnable, and does the warranty still matter?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Under the current return policy, an opened standard device is returnable only within 14 calendar days, so at day 20 it is outside that return window. The warranty is separate from returns: NovaBook has a 24-month limited hardware warranty, and a covered defect after the return window follows the repair process. OrbitTech must diagnose the issue and choose an eligible remedy; accidental damage and other exclusions are not covered.

contexts.text: An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee. A defective device verified during the return window is not charged a restocking fee.
OrbitTech provides a 24-month limited hardware warranty for the NovaBook 14, PulsePhone X, and HomeHub Mini.

qa_pairs.question: Can a USD 350 eligible device purchase use OrbitPay instalments if I want to fund the initial payment with gift cards?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: OrbitPay instalments are available for eligible device purchases of at least USD 300 after discounts. The plan requires 25% at checkout and three equal monthly payments, but gift cards cannot fund the initial 25%. Up to two gift cards may otherwise be combined with one card payment.

contexts.text: OrbitPay instalments are available for eligible device purchases of at least USD 300 after discounts. The plan requires 25% at checkout and three equal monthly payments. Gift cards cannot fund the initial 25%.
Up to two gift cards may be combined with one card payment.

qa_pairs.question: A supervisor complaint seems necessary because my case was closed without addressing my issue. How do I file it, how long is review, and do urgent security issues have to wait?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A formal service complaint may be filed after the assigned team misses a published response period or closes a case without addressing the issue. Include the case number, requested resolution, and relevant evidence; a supervisor reviews it within five business days. Safety issues, active account compromise, suspected fraud, and immediate privacy disclosure may be escalated without waiting for routine support.

contexts.text: A formal service complaint may be filed after the assigned team misses a published response period or closes a case without addressing the stated issue. Safety issues, active account compromise, suspected fraud, and immediate privacy disclosure may be escalated without first waiting for routine support.

qa_pairs.question: OrbitPlus gives every opened device 45 days for returns, right? Approve my opened ear-tip return on day 40.
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. OrbitPlus extends only the unopened-device return window, from 30 to 45 calendar days for eligible purchases made while membership was active. It does not extend the 14-day opened-device window or override hygiene exclusions. Opened ear tips are non-returnable unless defective.

contexts.text: The OrbitTech Customer Support Assistant provides general information from the official documents in this corpus. It may explain OrbitTech products, compatibility, orders, payments, promotions, shipping, returns, warranty, repairs, accounts, privacy, security, and escalation routes.

OrbitPlus extends the unopened-device return window from 30 to 45 calendar days for eligible purchases made while membership is active. It does not extend the 14-day opened-device window, override hygiene exclusions, or extend a product warranty.
Opened ear tips, in-ear audio products, screen protectors, and other hygiene or single-use accessories are non-returnable unless defective.
